data.name: AL-SARAB
data.detailed_description:
AL-SARAB is a psychological horror game inspired by classic survival horror, blending oppressive atmosphere, exploration, combat, and environmental storytelling in a dusty, decaying neighborhood that feels both familiar and deeply unsettling.

Wander through twisted alleys, abandoned spaces, and silent corners where something is clearly wrong. Search for key items, uncover hidden paths, solve grounded environmental puzzles, and survive disturbing encounters as the world around you grows more hostile and harder to understand.

Every location is built with purpose, filled with visual details, unsettling hints, and fragments of something larger waiting to be uncovered. The deeper you go, the more the city begins to feel alive — watching, shifting, and refusing to let you leave unchanged.

Face tense confrontations, explore at your own risk, and piece together a haunting experience shaped by atmosphere, dread, and the fear of what may be waiting just beyond the next corner.

Features

  • PSX-inspired psychological horror

  • A gritty Gulf-style urban setting

  • Environmental storytelling and grounded puzzles

  • Tense exploration, combat, and disturbing encounters

  • A world filled with mystery, unease, and hidden meaning

data.short_description: A PSX-style psychological horror game inspired by Silent Hill set in a distorted Gulf neighborhood, where familiar places turn hostile and every alley hides something wrong.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-6100 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 750 Ti / AMD Radeon R7 265
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 6 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible sound card
  • VR Support: N/A
  • Additional Notes: 64-bit processor and operating system required
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 / 11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 / AMD Radeon RX 580
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 6 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible sound card
  • VR Support: N/A
  • Additional Notes: SSD recommended, 64-bit processor and operating system required

content_descriptors.notes: This game contains depictions of violence, blood, disturbing imagery, and psychological horror themes. Players may encounter unsettling environments, grotesque enemy designs, scenes of injury or death, and story content involving trauma, guilt, and emotional distress. The game does not contain sexual content or depictions of sexual assault.
